definitions.gloss: being left behind, being abandoned, being excluded
definitions.explanation: The state of being left behind by others who have moved on. Can refer to physically being left somewhere or figuratively being excluded from a group activity or social trend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{置|お}いてけぼり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was the only one left behind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置|お}いてけぼり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I feel like I'm being left behind by technological progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧しまって、⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{置|お}いてけぼり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らって⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}した→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧。
examples.english: Everyone went on ahead, and my little brother started crying because he was left behind.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the pattern {置|お}いてけぼり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be left behind) or {置|お}いてけぼり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう (to get left behind). The word has a childish, colloquial nuance and conveys a sense of being unfairly excluded or forgotten.

ETYMOLOGY:
Derived from ⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧いく (to leave behind) with the suffix ぼり. Also written as {置|お}いてきぼり.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {置|お}いてけぼり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave someone behind
- {置|お}いてけぼり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be left behind
- {置|お}いてけぼり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう: to get left behind
